fullDescription:
Create complete hand-painted Ghibli worlds in Procreate with one connected brush system.

Ghibli-Inspired Procreate Brush System brings drawing, watercolor, nature, water, color, and paper texture tools into one clear workflow. Start with the first sketch, build the scene, blend the color, and add the final texture without jumping between unrelated brush packs.

Use 30 drawing brushes for expressive lines, clean shapes, and small details. Layer 29 watercolor and blending brushes for soft washes, rich color, and natural depth. Build clouds, trees, foliage, grass, wildflowers, water surfaces, ripples, foam, and underwater light with 134 nature and environment brushes. Finish the artwork with 10 paper texture brushes.

WHAT IS INCLUDED

• 30 Drawing brushes
• 29 Watercolor & Blending brushes
• 134 Nature & Environment brushes
• 10 Paper Texture brushes
• 5 Procreate color palettes with 30 colors each

The included palettes are Summer Sunset, Ghibli Botanical, Sakura Blossom, Ghibli Skin Tones, and Ghibli Seafoam.

MADE FOR

• Ghibli-inspired landscapes and story scenes
• Character and portrait illustration
• Clouds, forests, fields, flowers, and water
• Soft watercolor and vintage painted finishes
• Artists who want one organized process from sketch to final scene

Use the complete system from start to finish, or mix individual brushes into your own style. Every category has a clear role, so you can spend less time searching for tools and more time building your world.
